name: Nonconformity record draft
summary: A quality lead or supervisor who has spotted something wrong gets a draft record: the observation set against the stated requirement, the affected work counted from the register, and the containment options. The quality owner decides every call.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of quality management work, and its own rules for prepared work: the starter's notes and the stated requirement as the only authority, stated column headers with a stop when one does not match, suspected kept apart from confirmed, every gap written as a question, and nothing classified, held, sent or recorded until a person decides.
